rows.reasoning: Bradley voted Aye (18-15) on AB 103 (2025-2026), a single-subject bill whose operative section bars school staff from using a name or pronouns that do not align with a minor pupil's biological sex without written authorization from the parent or legal guardian, which matches the rung "Require parental permission before staff use a different name or pronouns" and goes beyond mere notification. His Aye votes on the multi-subject parents' bills of rights (AB 963, AB 510) point the same way but cannot carry a chair alone.
